about: The hosted deployment's pricing settings. Every price text states — docs/, the generated skills, the MCP tool descriptions, docs/choosing-models.md — is the CHARGED price at these settings (src/ee/billing/docs-pricing.ts).

charged: the deployment's price for each id it charges differently from the in-repo rule (STATIC_CREDIT_COSTS at these settings) — an admin's runtime reprice of a model_pricing row or of a per-service margin (the gpt-image-2 family is one), or an id only a private plugin prices. A figure, never scaled. REFRESH: cd backend && npm run docs:prices -- --live https://app.nodaro.ai --write, then npm run docs:prices -- --fix and npm run gen:skills.
cost_markup_percent and service_margin_percent mirror the deployment's admin settings, which no public endpoint serves: change them here when the admin settings change, then run --fix and gen:skills.
